title: Gone Coastal | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Private Pool Just Steps From Beach Access- Gone Coastal By Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Gone Coastal by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 157 Seacrest Drive, Seacrest, FL 32413 Details: Your dream 30A getaway awaits at Gone Coastal! Gather your family and friends for the ultimate beach escape at Gone Coastal, a stunning luxury home designed for unforgettable memories. Enjoy your private pool and spacious outdoor oasis, perfect for sunbathing, grilling, or relaxing after a day at the beach. Located just a short walk or bike ride to the nearby beach access at the end of Seacrest Drive, this home puts you right where you want to be—minutes from Alys Beach, The Big Chill, Rosemary Beach, and 30Avenue. You’ll have the best dining, shopping, and entertainment all within easy reach. Inside, you’ll find professional décor, high-end finishes, and plenty of room for everyone, ideal for large families, extended stays, or multiple couples with children. Every detail has been thoughtfully designed to deliver comfort, style, and that signature 30A coastal charm. Make Gone Coastal your next beach retreat and experience 30A’s east end the way it’s meant to be: relaxed, luxurious, and unforgettable. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: approximately 900 feet (3 min walk or 1 minute bike ride) -6 Complimentary Bikes -Ice Maker -Parking Spaces: 6 -Elevator -Plenty of Outdoor Seating -Ping Pong Table In Garage -Private Heated Pool* *Pool heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. -Event Friendly (with approval)* *Maximum Capacity: 50 people *Event Fee: $3,000 Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 18 7 Bedrooms/5.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: (En-Suite) King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Kitchen / Dining Area -Living Room -Half Bath -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 (Grande Suite 1): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 3: (En-Suite) King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 4: Open Bunk Room (1) Twin/Twin Bunk and (2) Twin Beds In Walkway To Carriage House -Access to Carriage House Third Floor: -Bedroom 5 (Grande Suite 2): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) Carriage House: Bedroom 6: Queen Bed with Shared Bath Bedroom 7: Bunk Loft (4) Twin Beds with Shared Bath Tower: -Half Bath Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes -Large Private Pool -Ice Maker -Ping Pong Table Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
